fire:
The farmers in the valley agreed that the
harvest would begin early this year.

Our lawyer told us that we should
not sign anything before Monday.

She opened the old wooden box and found
a bundle of letters from her grandmother.

In the morning the soldiers marched toward
the river and waited for orders.

Please remember that all visitors must
sign in at the front desk.

The recipe calls for two cups of
flour and a pinch of salt.

He explained that the bridge had been
closed since the storm in April.

We drove for hours along the coast until
we reached the small fishing town.
quiet:
The farmers in the valley agreed on the date.
The harvest will begin early this year.

Our lawyer gave us clear advice.
We should not sign anything before Monday.

She opened the old wooden box.
Inside was a bundle of letters.

In the morning the soldiers marched out.
They waited by the river for orders.

Please remember the rules.
All visitors sign in at the front desk.

The recipe is simple.
You need flour, salt and water.

He explained what had happened.
The bridge was closed after the storm.

We drove for hours along the coast.
Finally we reached the fishing town.
